lastCompletedStory.title: Terminal paths: abandon + merge-into modes in the spec writer

nextStoryContext: US-006 added abandonIssueOnMain and mergeIssueOnMain as sibling exports in src/commands/issue-specify.ts. Both reuse the same commit-tree-on-main plumbing (commitOnMain / commitTreeToMain / pushMainBestEffort) and DI'd SpawnFn. abandon sets status='abandoned'; merge-into records 'Merged into <targetId>.' in source.description (no new schema field; additionalProperties:false confirmed) and optionally folds blockedBy. Both validated with unit tests and real-git integration tests (45 tests total in the file). US-007 is next: add a production-wired observability event (kind 'spec-written' or 'stage-promoted') to specifyIssueOnMain. Event types live in src/supervisor/events.ts (WorkerEventKind union + makeFileEventLogger). The event must be emitted from the REAL call-site (not just injected fakes) so the production-wiring oracle (grep -q 'makeFileEventLogger' src/commands/issue-specify.ts) passes. Emit only on successful commit, not on guard/validation failure. A production-wiring test must drive the DEFAULT sink path, not only the injected fake, to catch an unwired default.

officialDocsValidated.summary: US-006 extends issue-specify.ts with abandon and merge-into modes. All git plumbing uses the same SpawnFn / node:child_process / node:fs pattern established in prior stories. No new external npm library was touched.
